ITA-3.17.2 kalalam कललम्
Stage of fetal development resembling the morula

ITA-3.12.1 kalā कला
Boundary between tissues
The general name given to the seven bodily membranes, e.g. fasciae or septae.
ITA-

.32 kalā कला
Time equivalent to approximately 71.64 seconds
Time equal to 30 kashtha.

ITA-1.9.3.4.1 kālaḥ कालः
Time as a continuum, one of the nine elementary causal substances (karanadravya).

ITA-1.11.9 kālaḥ कालः
Time
Time in general including the seasons, the point when something occurs (which may refer to diseases).

ITA-2.9.1 vayaḥ/kālaḥ वयः/ कालः
Age
Inevitable life events
ITA-

.43 kalāyakhañjaḥ कलायखञ्जः
Kesari palsy
A disorder characterized by trembling on walking; dragging walking/lameness; loss of joint control/loose joint ligaments.

ITA-3.8.17 kalāvikā कलाविका
Area four fingerbreadths proximal to the wrist
ITA-

kalkaḥ कल्कः
Paste

ITA-1.6.38 kalpanā कल्पना
Concept, hypothesis
A conceptual construction, the work of the imagination.

yakṛt, kālakhaṇḍaḥ, kālīyam, kālīyakam यकृत्, कालखण्डः, कालीयम्, कालीयकम्
Liver
ITA-

kālaja-balam कालजबलम्
Seasonal strength
Strength attained by virtue of a favourable season or age, i.e. winter season, youth.
ITA-

kālajarogaḥ कालजरोगः
Natural diseases of timely occurrence
Diseases and conditions that manifest in the body due to the natural effect of time and physiological changes such as hunger and thirst as well as the ageing process, e.g. greying of hair in old age.
ITA-

kālaprakarṣaḥ कालप्रकर्षः
Processing by retaining for long duration
A type of food processing which involves keeping food articles for long periods in order to obtain a beneficial modulation of their properties.

ITA-9.1.63 kālapratīkṣā कालप्रतीक्षा
Waiting period for appropriate treatment time
Understanding the stage of the disease condition and waiting for the appropriate time to initiate treatment, e.g. incision of an abscess only after it begins to suppurate.
ITA-

kālabalapravṛttarogaḥ कालबलप्रवृत्तरोगः
Diseases caused by diurnal and seasonal variations
Diseases and conditions that manifest in the body due to abnormal climatic variations such as excessive rain, heat or cold, and include conditions such as heatstroke or frost bite.

ITA-9.2.83 kālabastiḥ कालबस्तिः
Course of sixteen therapeutic enemas
A type of therapeutic enema based on a course of sixteen enemas which includes ten half-dose therapeutic ghee or oily enemas and six therapeutic decoction enemas, administered in a particular sequence.
ITA-

.29 kālamānaḥ कालमानः
Measurements of time

ITA-4.5.23 kālasamprāptiḥ कालसम्प्राप्तिः
Time-specific pathogenesis
A pathogenesis subclassification based on the time of occurrence or aggravation of the disease or condition.

ITA-3.16.19 kālāntaraprāṇaharamarma कालान्तरप्राणहरमर्म
Vulnerable location(s) leading to delayed death
Marma which if injured may lead to death within a period of thirty days.

ITA-3.14.8 Kālikā कालिका
Vein located in the ear

ITA-5.76.203 kālikā कालिका
Condition of fever, swelling due to improper piercing of child’s ear
A condition characterized by fever; burning sensation; swelling; pain.
